low_speed_at_altitude.description: Detects aircraft moving too slowly at high altitude (possible stall risk)

stationary_aircraft.description: Detects aircraft that have been nearly stationary for extended periods

rapid_altitude_change.description: Detects sudden altitude changes between snapshots

rapid_descent.description: Detects aircraft descending too quickly (possible emergency)

extreme_velocity.description: Detects aircraft moving at unrealistic speeds

altitude_bounds.description: Detects aircraft outside normal altitude ranges
